title: Sources: China targets 70%+ of silicon wafers that its chipmakers use to be made domestically by 2026's end, and has an unspoken mandate to use local 12" wafers (Nikkei Asia)
summary: Nikkei Asia: Sources: China targets 70%+ of silicon wafers that its chipmakers use to be made domestically by 2026's end, and has an unspoken mandate to use local 12" wafers — TAIPEI — China is aiming for more than 70% of silicon wafers used by its chipmakers to be made domestically by this year …
